fields.description: Short unique code, e.g. gst_registered. Not shown to users.
fields.label: Question Key

fields.description: The question the sales user sees, e.g. "Does the customer have a GST number?"
fields.label: Question

fields.description: Where the question appears: the Organization step or the Contact step.
fields.label: Applies To

fields.description: The user must answer this before continuing.
fields.label: Mandatory

fields.description: Tick to ask only when ERPNext customer setup is on. Untick to always ask, e.g. Territory or Industry.
fields.label: Requires ERPNext Bridge
Enabled
fields.description: Untick to stop asking this question.
Where the answer is saved.
fields.label: Target Doctype

fields.description: The field that gets the answer, e.g. gst_category. For a Sales Person question, use sales_team on Customer.
fields.label: Target Fieldname

fields.description: Fixed: you list the answers below. Dynamic: the answers come from records in another doctype, e.g. Sales Persons.
fields.label: Question Type

fields.description: Optional. Save the same answer on a second field too. Each answer then needs a Secondary Assigned Value.
fields.label: Secondary Target Doctype

fields.description: The field on that doctype.
fields.label: Secondary Target Fieldname

fields.description: Where the answers come from, e.g. Sales Person.
fields.label: Source Doctype

fields.description: The field shown as the answer text, e.g. sales_person_name. Leave empty to show the record name.
fields.label: Source Label Field

fields.description: Optional filter as JSON, e.g. {"enabled": 1}. Use {{ answers.question_key }} to filter by an earlier answer.
fields.label: Filters (JSON)

fields.description: Show this question only after another question is answered a certain way.
fields.label: Only After Question

fields.description: The Answer Key that must be chosen in that question.
fields.label: Only When Answer Is

fields.description: Is: show for that answer. Is not: show for every other answer.
fields.label: Match

fields.description: Value used when the user leaves this question unanswered.
fields.label: Fallback Value

fields.description: Question order; lower comes first. If two questions fill the same field, the later answer wins.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: Roles that can change the value on the Review step, one per line. Leave empty to allow nobody.
fields.label: Override Allowed For Roles
